population.inclusion: Austin campus. Suspected acute arterial ischemic stroke in the first 24 hours after onset. Use this sheet rather than the Houston algorithm. The parent guideline limits the population to age at least 1 month and symptom onset within 72 hours.
population.exclusion: Off algorithm when the Austin sheet says so. The parent guideline excludes age under 1 month, hemorrhagic stroke, traumatic brain injury, cerebral venous sinus thrombosis, and symptom onset after 72 hours.

When the chart is outside the inclusion population, or an exit criterion is present, you return no treatment card. You name the exit in one sentence. If a companion agent owns the situation, you name that agent and stop.
